values.description:
OHIP Gateway base URL for this environment. No trailing slash.
Example: https://sandbox.hospitality.oracle.com

x-app-key header value. From OHIP Developer Portal > Application > App Key.
NEVER commit real value to source control.

OAuth2 Client ID from OHIP Developer Portal > Application > Credentials.
NEVER commit real value to source control.

OAuth2 Client Secret from OHIP Developer Portal > Application > Credentials.
NEVER commit real value to source control.

Enterprise / environment identifier. Provided by Oracle / hotel IT.
Required when adding environments in OHIP Developer Portal.

OPERA property code (RESORT field in all CSV exports).
Used as x-hotelid header and as resort filter in all GraphQL queries.
Example: TEST01, HOTEL1, P4291
Hotel chain code. Used for multi-chain logging in SQL Server.

OAuth2 Bearer token. AUTO-POPULATED by '01 - Get OAuth Token' request test script.
Do not set manually — will be overwritten on each token call.

Unix timestamp (ms) when bearer token expires minus 60s safety margin.
AUTO-POPULATED by '01 - Get OAuth Token' request test script.

Start date for RES, FIN, OOO, and RMN queries (YYYY-MM-DD).
Typically: previous business date.
Example: 2026-07-29

End date for RES, FIN, OOO, and RMN queries (YYYY-MM-DD).
For single-day delta: same as startDate.
Keep range ≤ 7 days per call to avoid API volume limits.

OTB ConsideredDate range start (YYYY-MM-DD).
Typically: startDate + 1 day (first future date).
For OTB and Block Reservations queries.

OTB ConsideredDate range end (YYYY-MM-DD).
Typically: startDate + 365 days (1-year horizon).
For OTB and Block Reservations queries.
Keep range manageable — large ranges may hit API limits.
